For [dataframe](/docs/shell/commands/categories/dataframe/).

<div class='command-title'>Creates a sum expression for an aggregation or aggregates columns to their sum value.</div>

> **warning This command requires a plugin**
> The `polars sum` command resides in the `polars` plugin.
> To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_polars`.
> See the [Plugins](/docs/shell/book/plugins/) chapter in the book for more information.



## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> polars sum {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input             | output            |
| ----------------- | ----------------- |
| polars_expression | polars_expression |
| polars_selector   | polars_expression |
| polars_dataframe  | polars_dataframe  |
| polars_lazyframe  | polars_lazyframe  |
## Examples

Sums all columns in a dataframe
```nu
> [[a b]; [6 2] [1 4] [4 1]] | polars into-df | polars sum | polars collect
╭───┬────┬───╮
│ # │ a  │ b │
├───┼────┼───┤
│ 0 │ 11 │ 7 │
╰───┴────┴───╯

```

Sum aggregation for a group-by
```nu
> [[a b]; [one 2] [one 4] [two 1]]
                    | polars into-df
                    | polars group-by a
                    | polars agg (polars col b | polars sum)
                    | polars collect
                    | polars sort-by a
╭───┬─────┬───╮
│ # │  a  │ b │
├───┼─────┼───┤
│ 0 │ one │ 6 │
│ 1 │ two │ 1 │
╰───┴─────┴───╯

```
